
---
title: "Comparison of Complete Case and Multiple Imputation Analyses"
subtitle: "Regression Estimates and 95% Confidence Intervals for Maternal and Child Mortality"
format:
  html:
    toc: false
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(mice)
library(broom)
library(knitr)

# 1. Load data
finaldata <- readr::read_csv(
  "../../data/processed/final_data.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Match variable names used in the lecture
if (!"age_dep" %in% names(finaldata) &&
    "age_depr" %in% names(finaldata)) {
  finaldata <- finaldata |>
    rename(age_dep = age_depr)
}

if (!"loggdp" %in% names(finaldata)) {
  finaldata <- finaldata |>
    mutate(
      loggdp = if_else(
        gdp_1000 > 0,
        log(gdp_1000),
        NA_real_
      )
    )
}

# Check required variables
outcomes <- c(
  "maternal_mortality",
  "under5_mortality",
  "infant_mortality",
  "neonatal_mortality"
)

predictors <- c(
  "armed_conflict",
  "loggdp",
  "oecd",
  "pop_dens",
  "urban",
  "age_dep",
  "male_edu",
  "temp",
  "rainfall_1000",
  "earthquake",
  "drought"
)

required_vars <- c(
  "iso", "year", outcomes, predictors
)

missing_vars <- setdiff(
  required_vars,
  names(finaldata)
)

if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing columns: ",
    paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# 2. Prepare data for MICE
midata <- finaldata |>
  select(all_of(required_vars)) |>
  mutate(
    iso_num = as.integer(factor(iso))
  ) |>
  select(-iso)

# 3. Set up multiple imputation
mice0 <- mice(
  midata,
  seed = 100,
  maxit = 0,
  printFlag = FALSE
)

meth <- mice0$method

mi_vars <- c(
  "urban",
  "male_edu",
  "temp",
  "rainfall_1000",
  "loggdp",
  "pop_dens",
  "maternal_mortality",
  "infant_mortality",
  "neonatal_mortality",
  "under5_mortality"
)

meth[mi_vars] <- "2l.lmer"
meth["iso_num"] <- ""

pred <- mice0$predictorMatrix
pred[mi_vars, "iso_num"] <- -2
pred["iso_num", ] <- 0

# 4. Perform multiple imputation
mice.multi.out <- mice(
  midata,
  seed = 100,
  m = 10,
  maxit = 20,
  method = meth,
  predictorMatrix = pred,
  printFlag = FALSE
)

# Check that the requested number of imputations ran
stopifnot(mice.multi.out$m == 10)

# 5. Model formula
model_formula <- function(outcome) {
  reformulate(
    c(
      predictors,
      "as.factor(iso_num)",
      "as.factor(year)"
    ),
    response = outcome,
    intercept = FALSE
  )
}

# 6. Fit CC and MI models
mi_results <- list()
cc_results <- list()

imputed_datasets <- mice::complete(
  mice.multi.out,
  action = "all"
)

for (outcome in outcomes) {

  f <- model_formula(outcome)

  # Multiple Imputation
  mi_fits <- lapply(
    imputed_datasets,
    function(dat) {
      lm(f, data = dat)
    }
  )

  mi_pooled <- mice::pool(
    mice::as.mira(mi_fits)
  )

  mi_results[[outcome]] <- summary(
    mi_pooled,
    conf.int = TRUE,
    conf.level = 0.95
  )

  # Complete Case Analysis
  cc_fit <- lm(
    f,
    data = midata,
    na.action = na.omit
  )

  cc_results[[outcome]] <- broom::tidy(
    cc_fit,
    conf.int = TRUE,
    conf.level = 0.95
  )
}

# 7. Extract estimates and confidence intervals
format_results <- function(x, analysis, outcome) {

  x <- as_tibble(x)

  x |>
    transmute(
      outcome = outcome,
      term = term,
      analysis = analysis,
      estimate = estimate,
      lower = conf.low,
      upper = conf.high
    ) |>
    filter(term %in% predictors) |>
    mutate(
      result = sprintf(
        "%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
        estimate,
        lower,
        upper
      )
    ) |>
    select(outcome, term, analysis, result)
}

all_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(outcomes, function(y) {
    bind_rows(
      format_results(
        cc_results[[y]], "CC", y
      ),
      format_results(
        mi_results[[y]], "MI", y
      )
    )
  })
)

# 8. Create comparison table with readable names

comparison_table <- all_results |>
  mutate(
    term = recode(
      term,
      "armed_conflict" = "Armed Conflict",
      "loggdp" = "Log GDP per Capita",
      "oecd" = "OECD Membership",
      "pop_dens" = "Population Density",
      "urban" = "Urbanization",
      "age_dep" = "Age Dependency Ratio",
      "male_edu" = "Male Education",
      "temp" = "Temperature",
      "rainfall_1000" = "Rainfall",
      "earthquake" = "Earthquake",
      "drought" = "Drought"
    ),
    outcome = recode(
      outcome,
      "maternal_mortality" = "Maternal Mortality",
      "under5_mortality" = "Under-Five Mortality",
      "infant_mortality" = "Infant Mortality",
      "neonatal_mortality" = "Neonatal Mortality"
    ),

    # Combine Mortality Outcome and Analysis
    column_name = paste(outcome, analysis, sep = " - ")
  ) |>
  select(term, column_name, result) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = column_name,
    values_from = result
  ) |>
  rename(Predictor = term) |>
  select(
    Predictor,
    `Maternal Mortality - CC`,
    `Maternal Mortality - MI`,
    `Under-Five Mortality - CC`,
    `Under-Five Mortality - MI`,
    `Infant Mortality - CC`,
    `Infant Mortality - MI`,
    `Neonatal Mortality - CC`,
    `Neonatal Mortality - MI`
  )

```

## Regression Results

#| echo: false

knitr::kable(
  comparison_table,
  format = "html",
  caption = paste(
    "Table 1. Complete Case vs Multiple",
    "Imputation (m = 10)"
  ),
  align = "l",
  na = "—"
)
